2.title: Polls Show Advantage for Incumbent Parties in 4 Governor’s Races
2.summary: Democrats hold wide leads in Maine and Pennsylvania, as does the incumbent Republican in New Hampshire, but Michigan appears closer, according to New York Times/Siena polls.

3.title: Alaskans Dismayed, but Not Moved, by Peltola’s Treatment of Her Staff
3.summary: Voters interviewed in Anchorage and Fairbanks on Thursday said news that Mary Peltola, the Democratic nominee for Senate, had used offensive slurs would not change their vote.

4.title: Pope warns against 'losing humanity' to AI machines
4.summary: The pontiff delivered the warning on the first day of his trip to France on Friday.

5.title: Internet restricted after fighting breaks out in Ethiopia's Tigray region
5.summary: During the two-year civil war in Tigray, the region was totally cut off from the outside world.

6.title: 87-Year-Old Evicted From Her Home Tells Spaniards to ‘Fight’ to Avoid Same Fate
6.summary: María del Carmen Abascal, whose case has become a symbol of Spain’s housing crisis, appeared in a video from her hospital bed after police officers removed her from her apartment.
